_doc: RECORDED ADJUDICATIONS for the single-defensible-answer gate (see meshquiz/questions.py).
Every question whose SHAPE asks for membership of a set, with no uniqueness marker to pin
one member, must appear here with a one-line justification saying why exactly ONE of the
four options belongs to that set. An unlisted category question FAILS the build; a listed
question no longer in the bank ALSO fails, so this file cannot rot into a rubber stamp.
Keys are the question text, stripped and lowercased. Adding a question of this shape means
adding a line here — that is the point: it forces someone to check the other three options.
Seeded 2026-09-18 after 'Star Wars hero with lightsaber?' shipped with three defensible
answers; all 80 entries below were reviewed against the full curated bank that day.

reviewed.animals that lay eggs and fly?: Only birds both lay eggs AND fly; fish and snakes lay eggs but cannot fly, cats do neither.
reviewed.which is a us state?: Ontario/Alberta are Canadian provinces, Sonora a Mexican state; Texas alone is a US state.
reviewed.which is an island nation?: Peru, Chad and Mali are continental; Japan alone is an island nation.
reviewed.which is a search engine?: Excel, Word and Paint are desktop applications; Google alone is a search engine.
reviewed.wizard boy with a scar?: Frodo, Percy and Luke are not wizards; only Harry Potter is a scarred wizard boy.
reviewed.band with hey jude?: 'Hey Jude' is a Beatles single; the Stones, Queen and U2 never recorded it.
reviewed.game of thrones house with wolf?: The direwolf is the Stark sigil alone; Lannister=lion, Targaryen=dragon, Bolton=flayed man.
reviewed.sport with home runs?: A home run exists only in baseball among these four.
reviewed.sport with rackets and a net?: Tennis alone uses rackets over a net; boxing, rugby and sumo use neither.
reviewed.bird that cannot fly?: Eagles, crows and hawks all fly; the penguin alone is flightless.
reviewed.espresso is a type of?: Espresso is a coffee preparation, not a tea, juice or soda.
reviewed.which is a citrus fruit?: Apple is a pome, pear a pome, plum a stone fruit; lemon alone is citrus.
reviewed.which is a brass instrument?: Violin=string, flute=woodwind, piano=percussion/string; trumpet alone is brass.
reviewed.which country has the eiffel tower?: The Eiffel Tower is a single structure, in Paris, France.
reviewed.which is a landlocked country?: Cuba and Japan are islands, Italy has extensive coast; Chad alone is landlocked.
reviewed.which company makes android?: Android is developed by Google; Apple, Sony and IBM do not make it.
reviewed.which is a marvel hero?: Joker, Bane and Riddler are DC villains; Thor alone is a Marvel hero.
reviewed.country that hosts the tour de france?: The Tour is a French race; it makes brief foreign excursions but is hosted by France.
reviewed.which animal has a trunk?: Only the elephant has a trunk among horse, lion and zebra.
reviewed.which country is famous for pasta?: Italy is the pasta country; France, Spain and Greece are not so identified.
reviewed.which is served with maple syrup?: Maple syrup is the standard pancake accompaniment; not steak, soup or salad.
reviewed.sourdough is a type of?: Sourdough is a bread, never a soup, cheese or sauce.
reviewed.which is a string instrument?: Drum=percussion, flute=woodwind, horn=brass; violin alone is a string instrument.
reviewed.which role is hidden from the nodes list: Meshtastic hides REPEATER from the nodes list; CLIENT, ROUTER and TRACKER are all visible.
reviewed.role that broadcasts gps as priority?: TRACKER prioritises position broadcast; SENSOR prioritises telemetry, CLIENT and TAK neither.
reviewed.which us state is the grand canyon in?: The Grand Canyon lies wholly within Arizona.
reviewed.which continent is the sahara on?: The Sahara is entirely in Africa.
reviewed.which movie features the ship titanic si: Only the film 'Titanic' among these depicts the sinking.
reviewed.which sport has a quarterback?: The quarterback position exists only in American football here.
reviewed.which nut is in classic pesto?: Genoese pesto uses pine nuts; almond, cashew and walnut are variants, not the classic.
reviewed.which is a fermented soybean paste?: Roux=flour/fat, pesto=basil, aioli=garlic mayonnaise; miso alone is fermented soybean paste.
reviewed.a capella means singing with no?: A cappella means unaccompanied — no instruments. Words, audience and mic are unaffected.
reviewed.galaxy that contains our solar system?: The solar system sits in the Milky Way alone.
reviewed.river that carved the grand canyon?: The Colorado carved the Grand Canyon; Gila, Salt and Verde are other AZ rivers.
reviewed.az city that bought the real london brid: Lake Havasu City bought and re-erected London Bridge in 1968.
reviewed.az desert that shares a name with a sagu: Saguaro National Park sits in the Sonoran Desert.
reviewed.which planet rotates on its side (extrem: Uranus alone has an ~98 degree axial tilt.
reviewed.which planet rotates backwards (retrogra: Venus alone among these rotates retrograde. (Uranus also does, but is not offered.)
reviewed.which blood type is the universal donor?: O negative alone is the universal red-cell donor.
reviewed.which noble gas glows red-orange in sign: Neon glows red-orange; helium is pink-white, argon violet, radon is radioactive and unused.
reviewed.inventor credited with the telephone?: Bell holds the telephone patent credit; Edison, Tesla and Morse are credited with other inventions.
reviewed.which us president led during the civil: Lincoln was president throughout the Civil War; Grant was a general, not president until 1869.
reviewed.which sea has no land coastline?: The Sargasso is bounded by currents, not land; Coral, Baltic and Caspian all have coastlines.
reviewed.which fruit carries its seeds on the out: Strawberry achenes sit on the surface; apple, grape and cherry carry seeds inside.
reviewed.which vitamin is abundant in citrus frui: Citrus is the classic vitamin C source; A, B and D are not abundant in it.
reviewed.which grain is used to make risotto?: Risotto is made with rice (arborio/carnaroli), never wheat, barley or oat.
reviewed.a triangle with all sides equal is?: All-sides-equal is the definition of equilateral; scalene, isosceles and right are distinct.
reviewed.a light-year is a measure of?: A light-year is a distance, despite the name.
reviewed.which planet hosts the great red spot?: The Great Red Spot is Jupiter's storm.
reviewed.a space rock that lands on earth is a?: Once it lands it is a meteorite; meteor=the streak, asteroid=in space, comet=icy body.
reviewed.which continent is egypt in?: Egypt is in Africa (the Sinai is in Asia, but the country is African).
reviewed.which blood cells fight infection?: White cells are the immune cells; red carry oxygen, platelets clot, plasma is the fluid.
reviewed.which part of a plant makes food?: Photosynthesis happens in the leaf; root, stem and bark do not make food.
reviewed.which vitamin does sunlight help make?: UVB drives vitamin D synthesis; A, B and C are dietary.
reviewed.http is a protocol mainly for?: HTTP mainly serves web pages; email uses SMTP, printing IPP, video calls RTP/SIP.
reviewed.which superhero is from the planet krypt: Superman alone is Kryptonian; Batman and Flash are human, Thor is Asgardian.
reviewed.which of these birds cannot fly?: Eagle, sparrow and hawk all fly; the penguin alone is flightless.
reviewed.which instrument has black and white key: Piano alone here has a keyboard; guitar, drum and flute have none. (An organ also would, but is not offered.)
reviewed.which of these is a brass instrument?: Violin=string, flute=woodwind, piano=percussion/string; trumpet alone is brass.
reviewed.which drink naturally contains caffeine?: Coffee is naturally caffeinated; water, milk and juice are not.
reviewed.which of these is a citrus fruit?: Apple=pome, banana=berry/herb, peach=stone fruit; lemon alone is citrus.
reviewed.which famous canyon is in arizona?: Bryce and Zion are in Utah, Waimea in Hawaii; the Grand Canyon alone is in Arizona.
reviewed.which of these is a noble gas?: Iron, oxygen and sodium are not group 18; neon alone is a noble gas.
reviewed.which of these is an alkali metal?: Sulfur, calcium (alkaline EARTH) and argon are not group 1; potassium alone is.
reviewed.which of these is a halogen?: Copper, helium and carbon are not group 17; chlorine alone is a halogen.
reviewed.which element is a liquid metal at room: Mercury alone is liquid at room temperature; lead, sodium and tin are solid.
